wf_augi_01.title: Sable Studio
wf_augi_01.summary: Every wheelbase or track change meant re-pasting section JSON into chat and reading flat stiffness tables.
wf_augi_01.details: Existing catalog tools list component mass tables but cannot compare chassis options side by side in 3D. Sable gives the team one shared workspace to test structural trade-offs.

persona.name: Lukas Lindner
persona.quote: What happens if we stretch wheelbase to 3120 mm?

wf_augi_01.observed: Every wheelbase or track change meant re-pasting section JSON into chat and reading flat stiffness tables.
wf_augi_01.proposed: Sable Studio sweeps wheelbase, track, and wall gauge across SABLE-A/B/C in an interactive 3D cutaway view.
